archetypes.name: Kor Armory
archetypes.plan: Equip a wide Kor battlefield, use Armament Master to amplify every equipped creature, and finish with an aerial attack.

archetypes.name: Pumped Up
archetypes.plan: Pressure through the air, preserve tempo with efficient spells, and use kicker for a decisive late game.

archetypes.name: Rise of the Vampires
archetypes.plan: Build a Vampire force, trade life and creatures profitably, and let the tribe's removal and evasion close the game.

archetypes.name: The Adventurers
archetypes.plan: Chain Allies to grow the expedition, trigger their arrival abilities, and attack with a reinforced party.

archetypes.name: Unstable Terrain
archetypes.plan: Accelerate lands onto the battlefield, multiply landfall triggers, and overwhelm the opponent with large threats.
